headline: Confused by marketing words? Get clear answers.
body: 102 internet marketing terms explained in plain English, from A to Z, to help you understand the online world.
caption: Ever feel lost in the sea of internet marketing terms? We get it. Sometimes it feels like everyone's speaking a secret language. That's why we created 'The Internet Marketing Dictionary'. It's a free, practical guide that breaks down 102 common marketing terms, from A to Z, into simple, plain English. No more guessing what SEO or ROI means!
